talks.text: If the world's strongest army invaded tomorrow... how long would each country last? This is a simulation: we scored every country on soldiers, reserves, budget, size and population. Nuclear powers? They never fall.
And purple... more than a year, or never! Let's go!
United States: never! Nuclear weapons... and nobody can invade the United States.
Invade America? Good luck crossing the ocean.
Switzerland: 2 months. Mountains, bunkers, and 200,000 reservists.
Bunkers for every single citizen. Good luck.
One day? We would still be stuck in traffic.
We held off the Soviets in 1939. Ask them.
No army at all... but NATO would show up.
Ukraine: over 2 years. And in real life... it has lasted years.
A simulation? We have been doing it for real since 2022.
Saint Kitts and Nevis: under an hour.
Afghanistan: 3 months. The graveyard of empires.
Empires come here to die. Ask the British, the Soviets... and the Americans.
Small country. Very, very big army.
Ask France and America how that went.
Singapore: a month. Tiny, but armed to the teeth.
Invade us? Our nukes say hello.
Republic of the Congo: a week.
Vatican City: under an hour. The smallest country on Earth.
Hours? We have 135 guards... and God.
How long would your country last? Comment below!
